title: 64-Card Interconnect 800GB/s: Alibaba Cloud M890 Super Node Now on Sale
excerpt: August 12th news: Alibaba Cloud has officially launched the Lingjun Zhenwu M890 super node instance, which is now available for sale in the Wulanchabu region. E
content_html:
August 12th news: Alibaba Cloud has officially launched the Lingjun Zhenwu M890 super node instance, which is now available for sale in the Wulanchabu region. Enterprise customers can now activate high-speed inter-connected computing units with 64 cards in the cloud without building their own data centers. This instance can support MoE large models with up to ten trillion parameters for inference.

According to the introduction, the Lingjun Zhenwu M890 is the first super node form of computing power in China that has successfully run a large model with more than 2 trillion parameters. Kimi K3 and Qwen3.8Max have already been provided through this instance. This instance supports FP8 and FP4 low-precision computing, and by using the ICN Switch1.0 chip, it has increased the scale of Scale-up interconnection from 16 cards to 64 cards, achieving an inter-card bandwidth of 800 GB/s. In training scenarios such as intelligent driving and embodied intelligence, the training performance is three times that of the previous generation Zhenwu 810E.

As a foundational computing platform, the Alibaba Cloud Lingjun Intelligent Computing Platform relies on the HPN8.0 training and inference integrated network, supporting up to 130,000 heterogeneous computing cards in a single cluster, and can be further expanded to millions of cards, providing large-scale computing power support for large model training and inference.

The official launch of M890 marks that super node computing power is extending further from self-built infrastructure to public cloud services. As trillion-parameter and even ten-trillion-parameter MoE models enter the stage of large-scale deployment, high-speed inter-card connectivity, low-precision computing, and large-scale cluster scheduling capabilities are becoming important indicators in the competition of AI infrastructure.

content_html_zh:
8月12日消息：阿里云正式上线灵君真武M890超级节点实例，现已在乌兰察布地区开售。 企业客户现在可以在云端激活具有64卡的高速互连计算单元，而无需构建自己的数据中心。 该实例可支持高达十万亿参数的 MoE 大型模型进行推理。

据介绍，灵骏真武M890是国内首个成功运行超过2万亿参数的大型模型的算力超级节点形态。 Kimi K3和Qwen3.8Max已经通过该实例提供。 该实例支持FP8、FP4低精度计算，并通过使用ICN Switch1.0芯片，将Scale-up互联规模从16卡提升至64卡，实现卡间带宽800GB/s。 在智能驾驶、具身智能等训练场景中，训练性能是上一代真武810E的三倍。

阿里云灵君智能计算平台作为基础计算平台，依托HPN8.0训练推理一体化网络，单集群支持多达13万张异构计算卡，并可进一步扩展至百万张卡，为大模型训练和推理提供大规模算力支撑。

M890的正式发布，标志着超级节点算力从自建基础设施进一步向公有云服务延伸。 随着万亿参数甚至十万亿参数MoE模型进入大规模部署阶段，高速卡间连接、低精度计算和大规模集群调度能力正在成为AI基础设施竞争的重要指标。
